name: Bama Big Cubes 2024
information:
**This competition is on a Sunday**, the day after CubingUSA Southeast FMC Championship 2024, in which there will be a location in Birmingham, Alabama. We recommend checking out that competition as well once it goes public if you'd like to compete in FMC, though it is not recommended for beginners.

Due to space constraints, each competitior will be limited to 2 guests. If you require special accomodations, please reach out at least 2 weeks prior to the competition.

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org).
